title: Acceptance criterion web-client proves nothing
description:
FEATURE-API-Foundation.md [web-client]: accepts [200, 404]: 404 means the endpoint is absent, so this passes against an application that implements nothing. Assert 404 alone for a negative probe, or assert the status the implementation answers with. (assert response.status_code in (200, 404))

A criterion states one expectation. Pin the status the implementation answers with — a stub that answers is a real contract and a real test — or assert the not-found status alone as a deliberate negative probe. A criterion that needs a row to exist creates it through the public interface first rather than admitting the status that says it never existed.
